composition_variation: A single plump slightly flattened persimmon on a smooth cool white field. Rich warm vermilion-orange fruit silhouette with softly squared rounded shoulders and a small dip at the top; a compact deep moss-green four-lobed calyx sits slightly askew like a tiny cap, with a very short stem. Two minute charcoal half-lidded eyes and a very short horizontal mouth low on the fruit make it calm, quietly proud and charming. The cap is an essential part of the same subject, no extra leaves floating around. Fruit fills the center 58 percent width. Four flat colors including background, no fruit shine, dimensional shading, arms or feet. Elegant, endearing, memorable profile icon.
